text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—...!
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The mile... The Oka Sho is the ONE race—!
This is MY stage,
daaaaaamn iiit!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...One more time...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I have to stay true to myself, too...!
In order to offer up this victory—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Not yet, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, Bouquet-chan!
Right, the Sweetpea Stakes is coming up soon, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Not yet, not yet...! It's still not enough—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry to drop in so suddenly~.
It's a little early, but let's call it the eve of the festival♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(My clever, cute childhood friend, Curren-chan.
She's strong in races too... come to think of it, they used to call her the "Flashing Maiden.")

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I'm so happy after all! Getting to see Bouquet-chan take on the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I—I am truly grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't seen Curren-chan run,
I definitely wouldn't be here right now.

text_block_list.name: Young Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm going to win...!
—Haaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, amazing, that's amazing, Curren-chan!
Sparkling bright, united with everyone...
—just like a bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan, who is always full of smiles,
fought with such serious determination in her eyes...
It was so, so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The joy of sprinting across the turf.
The exhilaration of dreaming together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who taught me
the beauty of "harmony" in a race,
where everyone strives for victory, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
...Curren-chan! I...!
My very first race was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's passionate feelings clashed
and became one—!
I'm sure I was able to become a bouquet too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you for inviting me into the world of racing back then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♡ After all, Curren just knew that
you'd come to love racing, Bouquet-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Bouquet-chan never changes.
She's always kind to everyone, and that's precisely why
she can become so incredibly strong for someone else's sake."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Especially right now, I can really, truly feel how much she wants to give it her all."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Watching you, I could tell
you've found feelings that are truly precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is......
Yes, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right?♪
Then we're definitely going to be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "There's no girl stronger than a Bouquet-chan shining bright with the desire to do it 'for you'♡"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Hehe, having Curren-chan cheering for me
is worth a hundred allies."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, I'll do my best.
With everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *phew*—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I can still remember it like it was yesterday.
The day I first looked up at Tracen Academy.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (The stiffness of the violet uniform before getting used to it—and the day I got lost on my way to the grounds.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (And about... the days that followed――)

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"Stay aggressive, Bouquet! Stay aggressive!
If you don't go on the offensive, you can't win!"

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "The secret to getting stronger? ...In the end, what matters most is the feeling that 'I want to win!'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "You know, I want everyone to know that Curren is the absolute cutest. That's why I want to win races."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Hearing so many words—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I've only just broken out of my slump.
I know there isn't much time left.
If I want to secure my debut, I can't afford to lose today."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I just don't have the talent.
So, if I don't get scouted in today's Debut Race, I'm planning to quit."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"I just have to win, no matter what!
The senior I look up to is coming to watch!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "That's why I absolutely want to win!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Now that I know how everyone feels...
I will—)

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"‘Racers for the next round,
please get ready to enter the gate~’"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Yeees!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: “――‘I want to win.’”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to win.’
‘No matter what, I want to win.’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
""......
I want her to win...""

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (More and more, little by little, about myself—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "......Finished."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Grow big and strong.
Harmonizing with everyone—
I know you'll make a beautiful planter."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"'...—
It seems... it was too difficult for me... after all.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (A ray of light that descended upon those days.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me—!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Would you... please become my Trainer...?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ("I want to win for you"—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "And, gathering more victories than these two hands can hold..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "—I want to deliver a bouquet shining in gold to you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Before I knew it, my heart was filled with a warm light.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Meeting you was, without a doubt, like meeting the sun.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall dedicate
the finest sweet pea to you.
—I involuntarily catch my breath.
Her gaze was filled with determination, completely transformed from the diffident way she ran before being scouted.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out and forevermore,
collecting so many, many beautiful flowers."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And without fail, I will gather the golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
She bathed in so much...
so very much sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"That warmth became the strength that—
caused the tight bud to blossom."
